Method of Attack: Malicious Word (.doc) attachments or links to download them containing macros that install malware
Use of malicious macros executed after user enables content
Installation of additional malware (Trickbot, QBot) that steal passwords, cookies, banking info
Provision of access to threat actors who install ransomware (Conti via Trickbot, ProLock via QBot)
Attack Vector: Spam email campaigns with malicious attachments pretending to be invoices, shipping info, COVID-19 info, resumes, financial or scanned documents
User interaction required to enable macros ('Enable Content' and 'Enable Editing' prompts)
